title: Secret Origins #8 DC 1986 Shadow Lass Doll Man Origin Steve Lightle Cover
conditionDescription: Bright, glossy front cover; small chip/stain at the bottom right corner. Back cover lightly toned. See photos.
descriptionText:
Secret Origins #8 (November 1986), DC Comics - origins of Shadow Lass (by Paul Levitz and Tom Mandrake) and Doll Man (by Roy Thomas and Murphy Anderson). Cover by Steve Lightle. $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: Starburst & Skittles Sportacular ad.

Condition: bright, glossy front cover with a small chip/stain at the bottom right corner; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
